input.quote: Each Service Option Attachment will renew automatically for an additional term equal in duration to the previous term of the applicable Service Option Attachment unless either party notifies the other party in writing at least ninety (90) days prior to the end of the then-current term for the applicable Service Option Attachment that it has elected to terminate such Service Option Attachment.
input.rationale: Section 3.2 provides automatic renewal but requires 90 days' written notice to prevent renewal, which exceeds the fallback ceiling of a 60-day non-renewal notice window and sits at the outer edge of walk-away territory. Renewal pricing is also uncapped: Section 13.1 lets IBM change Service Option Attachment prices after 12 months on 90 days' notice with no percentage limit, so renewal uplift is unconstrained (Customer's only protection is a termination right). We therefore target the fallback: notice window cut to 60 days and any renewal-term charge increase capped at 5% of the preceding term. We have left the renewal-term length (equal to the prior term) untouched as it is not a fallback element, but note that if an Order Form term is multi-year the renewals will also be multi-year, which we would prefer to fix to 12 months.

proposal.summary: Shorten non-renewal notice window to 60 days and cap renewal-term charges at 5%.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We shortened the non-renewal notice window from 90 to 60 days and capped any renewal uplift at 5% of the prior term's charges, consistent with our fallback renewal position.

ops.oldText: at least ninety (90) days prior to the end of the then-current term
ops.newText: at least sixty (60) days prior to the end of the then-current term

ops.text: Charges for each renewal term will not exceed one hundred five percent (105%) of the charges in effect for the immediately preceding term of the applicable Service Option Attachment.

mappings.element: If renewal is automatic, Customer's non-renewal notice window is no more than 60 days.
If renewal permits price increases, each increase is capped at 5 percent.
